content: Řḥukm issaggʷaden x Mu’ab. “Di ǧiřet ittwahdem Ar-Mu’ab, idweř issusem, wah, di ǧiřet ittwahdem Qir-Mu’ab, idweř issusem!
Geɛɛden ɣar Bayit d Dibun, ɣar řegɛudi ḥima ad run. Dinni ad iru Mu’ab x Nabu d Maydaba. Qaɛ azeǧif nsen iřsa d aqeccar, marra timira ttwaḥeffent.
Beysen s txuncay n wecḍan deg izniqen nsen, aqa din mɣir tɣuyyit x tzeɣwin nsen u deg wazzayen nsen, imeṭṭawen weṭṭan-dd x uɣembub.
Ḥacbun isɣuyyu, uřa d Aliɛala. Ttesřan i tmijja nsen ař Yahaṣ. X uya sɣuyyun uřa d iryazen n Mu’ab nni ɣar iǧa řesnaḥ, buḥbeř n mkuř aryaz ifceř dayes.”

“Uř inu isɣuyyu x Mu’ab. Imarwařen nnes iwḍen ař tandint n Ṣuɣar, tenni iǧan am taɛejmit n třata n iseggʷusa. Am ttrun ttgeɛɛaden tasawent n Luḥit, wah, deg webrid ɣar Ḥurunayim ssgaɛɛaden nitni taɣuyyit n txessart.
Wah, aman n Nimrim ad dewřen imucan xřan, wah, arbiɛ isřaw, aɣemmuy n arbiɛ iqḍa, war ittiři ɛad uɣemmuy aziza.
X uya ad arbun min iceṭṭen d min ɛad ɣarsen, ɣar ujemmaḍ n iɣzar n Iṣefṣafen.
Wah, ad dd-teffeɣ tɣuyyit n ucetci di temmurt n Mu’ab, aweɛɛeḍ nnes ad dd-iffeɣ ař Ajlayim, aɣuyyi s imeṭṭawen ař Bi’r-Ilim.
Ɛad ccuren waman n Dimun s idammen, waxxa Necc ad arenyeɣ x Dibun ɛad ktar: ayrad ad dd-yas x yinni dd-yarewřen zi Mu’ab, x min iqqimen di temmurt.”
